## Summary

Describe the user-facing or registry change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] Source, license, compatibility, privileges, network, and restart declarations are present
- [ ] Virtual Setup commands come from identifiable upstream evidence
- [ ] Standalone assets include SHA-256 and lifecycle test evidence
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, or generated user data are committed

## Evidence

Attach screenshots, logs, or links needed to verify the change.
